Rediscover terror in this reimagined classic survival horror. He'll haunt👻 you this January - 😱Slender Reborn😱 is coming out on Steam

notes.title: Steam Game Awards 2024 Badge
notes.content:
Hello players,

Do you know that in just max 5 minutes you can

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/fa2c17bbdab2eb283571d4a1fee7965c2975d4e7.jpg

[olist]
 Support developers of this game
 Get a cool Steam Awards Community badge that boosts your Steam level
 Be happy to be involved in a Community Event
 Be one of the chosen to create a great community of players
[/olist]

You just need to:

1. Nominate the game of your choice for the award

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/2220956f7f46f0791840f21607a665909825c890.jpg

You just go to the game Steam card and there will be a banner just under the trailers/screenshots section.

2. Nominate other games ideally one of the FreeMind games

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/0c9eead3ebeae09916fa8ae1c5c99b9942ebb00d.png

You go to the main Steam page and click on the banner above, nominate a game of your choice.

3. Create or update a review of the game

4. Start and play the nominated game

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/7fc9558d463c0eab92caed37366389e22c4b0596.jpg

If you are having problems, just let us know we will try to help.

FreeMind team.

PS. If you want to support us and you think our game/s deserves a nomination, you can do your badge just with us, though it would be quite impressive if you held all of our titles.

Here is just an example that CreativeForge Games can be nominated in 10 out of 11 categories

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/537e50d006e5462df2fe616ea052bc09015842eb.jpg
